# Overview

This report is generated automatically by the daily **Ebola Analytics
Pipeline**. It shares its data, parameters, prediction zones, and
coefficients with the interactive portal.

Workflow: prepare data -> wrangle -> compute primary parameters ->
train the SIR model -> test on a holdout -> assess performance ->
project the next 14 days.

Population at risk: 20,000,000 persons.

# STEP 1 — Data Preparation

```{r}
knitr::kable(head(raw, 5), caption = "Raw upstream series")
```

```{r}
  caption = "Cleaned series"
)
```

# STEP 3 — Primary Parameters

```{r}
param_table <- data.frame(
  Parameter = c("Population at risk (N)",
                "Initial susceptible (S0)",
                "Initial infectious (I0)",
                "Growth rate (r)",
                "Recovery rate (gamma)",
                "Mortality rate (mu)",
                "Transmission rate (beta)",
                "Basic reproduction number (R0)"),
  Value = c(format(N_total, big.mark = ","),
            format(round(S0), big.mark = ","),
            format(round(I0), big.mark = ","),
            sprintf("%.4f /day", growth_rate),
            sprintf("%.4f /day", gamma_est),
            sprintf("%.4f /day", mu_est),
            sprintf("%.4f /day", beta_est),
            sprintf("%.3f", R0_est))
)
knitr::kable(param_table, caption = "Primary parameters derived from raw data")
```

**Key calculations**

- Growth rate (r): log-linear regression on the first 30 percent of the
  daily incidence series.
- Recovery rate (gamma): gamma = 1 / 10 days.
- Mortality rate (mu): mu = (CFR / 100) / infectious period.
- Transmission rate (beta): beta = r + gamma + mu.
- Reproduction number (R0): R0 = beta / (gamma + mu).

```{r}
test_df <- data.frame(

)
knitr::kable(test_df, caption = "Holdout window")
```

# STEP 6 — Model Performance

```{r}
perf_tbl <- data.frame(
  Window = c("Train", "Test", "Overall"),
  RMSE   = round(c(train_perf$rmse, test_perf$rmse, overall$rmse), 2),
  MAE    = round(c(train_perf$mae,  test_perf$mae,  overall$mae),  2),
  R2     = round(c(train_perf$r2,   test_perf$r2,   overall$r2),   3)
)
knitr::kable(perf_tbl, caption = "SIR model performance metrics")
```

# Epidemic Curve — Observed Streams

```{r fig.height=5}
ts_long <- outbreak_df %>%
  select(date, suspected, confirmed, deaths) %>%
  pivot_longer(-date, names_to = "stream", values_to = "value") %>%
  mutate(stream = recode(stream,
    suspected = "Suspected",
    confirmed = "Confirmed",
    deaths    = "Deaths"
  ))

ggplot(ts_long, aes(x = date, y = value, colour = stream)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.0) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(
    "Suspected" = "#e67e22",
    "Confirmed" = "#e74c3c",
    "Deaths"    = "#7f8c8d"
  ), name = "Series") +
  labs(x = "Time (Date)", y = "Cumulative count",
       title = "Observed cumulative cases and deaths") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = "right")
```

# SIR Compartments — with beta, gamma, mu Reference Lines

```{r fig.height=6}
sir_long <- sir_full %>%
  select(time, S, I, R, D) %>%
  pivot_longer(-time, names_to = "compartment", values_to = "value")

compartment_peak <- max(sir_long$value, na.rm = TRUE)
rate_peak        <- max(c(beta_est, gamma_est, mu_est), na.rm = TRUE)
scale_factor     <- if (rate_peak > 0) compartment_peak / rate_peak * 0.35 else 1

param_df <- data.frame(
  y     = c(beta_est, gamma_est, mu_est) * scale_factor,
  label = c(sprintf("beta = %.3f",  beta_est),
            sprintf("gamma = %.3f", gamma_est),
            sprintf("mu = %.3f",    mu_est)),
  col   = c("#c0392b", "#27ae60", "#8e44ad")
)

ggplot(sir_long, aes(x = time, y = value, colour = compartment)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.1) +
  geom_hline(data = param_df,
             aes(yintercept = y, colour = label),
             linetype = "dotted", linewidth = 0.8, show.legend = FALSE) +
  annotate("text",
           x = max(sir_long$time) * 0.98,
           y = param_df$y,
           label = param_df$label,
           hjust = 1, vjust = -0.4,
           colour = param_df$col, size = 3.3, fontface = "bold") +
  labs(x = "Days since first report",
       y = "Individuals (scaled for reference lines)",
       title = "SIR compartments with parameter reference lines",
       colour = "Compartment") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = "right")
```

# Model Fit vs Observed Cases

```{r fig.height=5}
fit_df <- data.frame(
  date      = outbreak_df$date,
  Observed  = observed_I,
  Predicted = round(predicted_I, 0)
) %>%
  pivot_longer(-date, names_to = "series", values_to = "value")

ggplot(fit_df, aes(x = date, y = value, colour = series, linetype = series)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(
    "Observed"  = "#1f2d3d",
    "Predicted" = "#e74c3c"
  ), name = "Series") +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c(
    "Observed"  = "solid",
    "Predicted" = "dashed"
  ), name = "Series") +
  labs(x = "Time (Date)", y = "Cumulative cases",
       title = "Observed vs SIR fitted cumulative cases") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = "right")
```
